Frontend Engineer at Bluebird Analytics

About the role:
Bluebird Analytics is hiring a frontend engineer to build dashboards for wind farm operators.

Requirements:
- Three years of JavaScript
- Experience with REST APIs

Preferred:
- TypeScript
- Test automation experience

Responsibilities:
- Build accessible interfaces
- Pair with designers

Benefits:
- Health insurance
- Flexible hours

How to apply:
Email careers@bluebird.example with your resume.
